purpose: Candidate non-B524 eBUS value-name queue; no rename or runtime mapping is authorized.
coverage: Partial: explicit identifier-shaped value fields and value-name columns only. Transport metadata, operation names and unrelated protocols are excluded. Prose-only labels and unnamed values remain unassessed. Identical spellings do not establish identical native identities. Candidates require a value-name position: a fixture name or value-name field, a value-name column cell, or a structured declaration. Markdown table headers, column captions, metadata labels and capitalised prose alone do not qualify; a spelling also used as a caption is retained only when it has a value-name position.
